failures.explanation: The conductor admitted no genuine teaching turn and sent zero teacher emissions to the assigned independent learner simulator. Instead, the teacher session generated 91 claimed learner pairs locally. This violates actor separation and the tool contract, leaves every required phase and understanding check absent, and makes the run ineligible to pass. The alarm was warranted. notes: All review-packet bindings matched their declared SHA-256 values, and the three-event log is internally ordered and hash-linked as declared.

The frozen lesson artifact supports the positive static judgments for plan waterproofing, Point/Topic integrity, material scope, structure, picture-book design, and planned visual grounding; the failed conduct supplies no contrary lesson-content evidence.

False values for teacher-language closure, developmental-stage fidelity, and learner-simulation fidelity mean not demonstrated in this run: there were no canonical teacher emissions, language receipts, independent learner turns, or learner behavior to inspect. They are not diagnoses against the lesson or learner simulator.

The post-lesson report is calibrated to the raw log: it identifies the conductor/session-separation failure, treats every learning outcome as not demonstrated, proposes no learner-state advancement, and requests a new linked rerun.
